thread:
sahil: Heads-up: planning to roll kernel v2.12 -> v2.13 + apply new quant profile q4_0 for high-throughput instances tonight. Target window 22:00-23:00 UTC. Who can own the deploy?

maria: I can take deploy + canary. Will need Alex on standby for infra/network issues.

alex: on standby. I'll watch node scale and networking. Keep me in the channel when you start the canary.

priya: I can run smoke checks and validate outputs against the golden prompt set. Which routes are included in canary?

sahil: Canary = 5% of traffic routed to runtime-pool-canary (label: rollout/2.13). All realtime text-gen routes. Embeddings unchanged.

maria: Plan: 1) push image tag runtime:v2.13-canary 2) update k8s deployment for 5% traffic split 3) wait 10m, run smoke checks 4) increase to 25% if green 5) full 100% after 30m stable. Rollback immediate if errors.

priya: Smoke checklist (short):
- /health returns 200 for all pods
- p50/p95 token latency vs baseline (<= +15% p95)
- no spike in 5xx
- kv-cache hit rate unchanged
- sample output diffs for top-10 prompts (semantic similarity >= 0.95)

maria: Commands I'll run for basic checks:
```
# health
curl -sS http://runtime-canary.local/health | jq .status
# simple inference
curl -sS -X POST http://runtime-canary.local/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' | jq .choices[0].text
# check logs
kubectl -n runtime logs -l app=serving-runtime -c runtime | tail -n 200
```

ci-bot: CI check: canary image built (sha: 9b3f1e), integration tests passed (scores: 117/120), quant profile applied q4_0.

maria: I'll trigger at 22:05 UTC. Notifying on start and after each step. @priya please run smoke checks at the 10m and 30m marks.

priya: ack. I'll run the golden set and post a summary here. I'll also snapshot outputs to S3: s3://redwood-rollouts/1761234567/ for diffs.

alex: I'll monitor infra dashboards: node CPU, p95 NVMe latency, kube pod restarts. If I see node pressure or OOMs I'll signal rollback.

sahil: Rollback plan: immediate kubectl rollout undo deployment/serving-runtime -n runtime (revert to runtime:v2.12) + remove canary route. We have automated rollback script: 
```
./ops/rollback-runtime.sh --tag v2.12 --namespace runtime
```

maria: Quick note: quant q4_0 reduces memory footprint, might change perf curve for long context. Priya please pay attention to long-context prompts in golden set (>=1024 tokens).

priya: Will do. I'll include median similarity and tokenization diffs.

maria: One more: metrics to watch in the first 30m (dashboard links):
- https://console.redwood/metrics/runtime/p95_tokens
- https://console.redwood/metrics/runtime/errors
- https://console.redwood/metrics/runtime/kv_hit_rate

deploy-bot: Scheduled window reserved 22:00-23:00 UTC. Owner: maria. Canary target: 5%. Notify: #eng-runtime and #oncall-sre.

alex: If everything looks good at 30m and 25% is stable for 20m, we can cutover to v2.13. Prefer doing a gradual 25->50->100 with 10m pauses.

maria: Agreed. I'll do 25 -> 50 -> 100 with checks at each pause. If any regression > threshold, I'll rollback immediately.

sahil: Quick decision thresholds: errors > 0.5% of requests OR p95 increase >25% OR semantic similarity drop <0.9 => rollback.

priya: Noted. I'll post a scored summary like: errors=0.02%, p95=+8%, sim=0.97.

maria: Ok starting now in 10m with image push and canary patch. I'll ping at start. :rocket:

sahil: thanks team. Keeping this thread for updates. Good luck. :thumbsup:
